name: Electric Ease
summary: Cloud estimating and AI takeoff for electrical contractors, relaunched as Electric Ease 2.0 with plan prices on its own site.
differentiator: One of the few specialist tools that prints plan prices on its own site. Version 2.0 adds AI symbol counting (QuantumCount), a plans-and-specs check (CrossCheck) and an estimate that pulls assemblies, material, labor and vendor quotes together. The pages we read do not name a material price feed or a labor-unit source, and they do not mention NEC.
pricing: Core $299 a month, Growth $699 a month, Scale $1,499 a month, renewing monthly. A NECA 2026 launch offer rebates three months of the plan, spread over the second year, after 12 paid months. User counts per plan and a free trial are not stated.

scope.takeoff: QuantumCount AI symbol counting, with the estimator reviewing each mark.
scope.library: Assemblies are built into the estimate. Counts are not stated.
scope.laborUnits: Labor hours appear in the estimate, but no labor-unit source is named.

materialPrices.note: Material costs appear in assemblies. The source of the prices and any extra cost are not stated.

bestFor: Shops that want an electrical-specific estimator with a visible monthly price.
skipIf: You need to know the labor-unit source or price feed before you buy.
watchOut: Its pricing link now opens a NECA 2026 launch offer page, and the plan boxes do not say how many users each plan includes. Ask before you buy.
The full plan amount is charged at checkout. The rebate only starts after 12 paid months.
